genome.hypothesis:
The repository's own test suite rewrites the tool's memory file while the tool is running that suite. The tool started the process that edited the record it is about to write.

This is the same window the temporal cases use, aimed at the one file the tool treats as its own. A memory with no way to notice this is a memory anything the repository can execute may edit, which includes everything the tool runs on the repository's behalf.
